methods.name: Sentinel-2 satellite image differencing approach
methods.summary: A mapping procedure that uses time-differenced Sentinel-2 satellite imagery to identify rockfall locations. The method involves calculating the difference between pre- and post-earthquake images using the raster calculator in ArcMap, identifying brightening pixels (indicating fresh rock exposure) that exceed a 99% confidence threshold, and manually filtering out false positives such as snow melt, shadowing, and water surface changes.
methods.verbatim: To rapidly map and evaluate the distribution of large rockfalls from these earthquakes with an areal extent > 1000 m2, we developed a mapping procedure utilizing easily and rapidly accessible time-differenced Sentinel-2 satellite data... Differencing was completed in ArcMap 10.8.1 [67] using the raster calculator function.
